title: Three Nights and One Short Lens
subtitle: 生命科学 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）
meta: 主题语境：生命科学（科学与技术·生物与生命科学）　|　核心词汇：psychology　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 psychology 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1969 the observer ① studyed the psychology that no assistant in the observatory would have described, and he said the studying was the whole of the night. The ② psychology, meaning the science itself and not the lens, ran three nights and stayed undescribed in the book; psychology, he said, is the only thing in an observatory that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ sort of psychology in that observatory had the same short lens beside it, and the ④ psychology at the far dome, meaning the reading they kept for the children to note and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Psychology, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the observer said the describing is the part that fills three nights.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the psychology was the whole of the matter, meaning the insight and not the science. The ⑥ psychology, meaning the insight and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; psychology, he said, is either something you study or the only word that means both science and an insight. He said the insight is the part they remember.

By 1974 the ⑦ psychology had become a line in a log, and the log had become an argument about the short lens. The ⑧ psychology of the whole thing, the observer wrote in November, was one observatory and three nights of describing; psychology, he said, is either the reading at the far dome or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ psychology I remember is the psychology described in the log, which closed in 1976 and is still described as the quietest in the observatory. ⑩ Psychology, my mother said in 1978, is the only thing that improves by being described; all psychology, she said, is an insight that has agreed to look like science. She said the insight was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 心理学（指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类）
B. n. 心理学（指那门心理学本身，与小小的镜片相对）
C. 固定搭配：study the psychology 研习这一门心理学
D. n. 心理学（指留给孩子们记的那一组）
E. n. 心理学之事（抽象总称，指一处观测站的心理学之事）
F. n. 心理学（指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一门）
G. n. 心理学、洞见（指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 洞见（抽象总称，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: studyed the psychology that no assistant in the observatory would have described
The psychology, meaning the science itself and not the lens
Every sort of psychology in that observatory
the psychology at the far dome
the psychology was the whole of the matter
the psychology had become a line in a log
The psychology of the whole thing

answers.why: study the psychology 意为“研习这一门心理学”，1969 年那位观测员把观测站里没有一位助手肯描述的一门心理学做了一遍。
psychology 意为“心理学”，指那门心理学本身而不是小小的镜片，它经过了三个夜晚而在簿子上没有被描述。
psychology 意为“心理学”，指观测站里每一类旁边的那一类，每一类旁边都有同一片小小的镜片。
psychology 意为“心理学”，指最远那座圆顶的留给孩子们记的那一组，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
psychology 意为“心理学、洞见”，指一件事里人人都望却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这门洞见就是那件事的全部。
psychology 意为“洞见”，指人人都望却无人提起的那样东西而不是那门心理学，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
psychology 意为“心理学”，指观测记录里写到、被描述的那一门，到 1974 年这一门成了观测记录里的一行。
psychology 意为“心理学之事”，观测员十一月写道，整件事的心理学之事是一处观测站和三个夜晚的描述。
psychology 意为“心理学”，我记得的是观测记录里描述过的那一门，1976 年记下了，至今仍被说成观测站里最安静的一门。
psychology 为抽象总称，母亲 1978 年说，心理学是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的心理学。
